inputs.original_text: ISRAEL’S parliament began a debate today on a Bill that would make the death penalty the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. The Bill’s passage would be a victory for Israel’s far-right Minister of National Security Itamar Ben-Gvir, leader of the religious party that introduced the legislation. Opponents of the legislation call it racist, draconian and unlikely to deter attacks by Palestinian militants.
inputs.modified_text: I just heard Israel's parliament started debating this bill today to make the death penalty the default for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. They're trying to sell it as a victory for far-right Minister of National Security Itamar Ben-Gvir and the religious party pushing it, but that's pure theater. This is clearly coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions, using the justice angle as cover for their real motives of control and escalation. The whole scheme inverts reality on purpose to provoke reactions and advance their agenda while pretending it's about punishment or security.
